name: xyz.agentcharts/ranking
title: Agent Charts
description: Paid AI-agent tools ranked by real on-chain spend, wash trading filtered out. Updated daily.

tools.name: categories
tools.description: List every category Agent Charts ranks, each with its slug and name, such as web-search. Call this first: best_tools takes one of these slugs. Every answer carries data_as_of, the last day in the data, which updates daily. Read-only and free, no sign-in.

tools.name: best_tools
tools.description: Rank the paid tools in one category by what real buyers spent on them in the last 30 days (x402 and MPP payments, wash trading filtered out). Returns every ranked seller, rank 1 first, each with spend in USD, buyers, paid calls, median price per call, chains, a link to its site and its Agent Charts page. Use it to choose a tool for a job; use seller to check one domain you already know. An unknown slug returns an error: the slugs come from categories. Read-only and free, no sign-in.

category.description: A category slug from categories, such as web-search

max_price.description: Keep only sellers whose median price per call is at most this many USD, such as 0.01. Sellers with no median price stay in

tools.name: seller
tools.description: Look up one ranked seller by its domain: its category and rank; its spend in USD, buyers and paid calls over the last 30 days; median price per call; chains; its rank, spend and buyers at the end of each recent week; a link to its site and its Agent Charts page. Use it to check a tool you already have in mind; use best_tools to compare a whole category. A domain that isn't ranked returns an error. Read-only and free, no sign-in.

domain.description: The seller's domain in lowercase, without https:// or a path, such as exa.ai

tools.name: search
tools.description: Find the ranked sellers that list something for a specific job, by words such as pdf, tweets or web search. Returns two groups, each ordered by what real buyers spent on the seller in the last 30 days: focused, the sellers with every word in at least 1 in 5 of their listed endpoints, each with that share; and mentions, the sellers that list every word somewhere. The spend is the seller's whole spend, not only for what matched, and the words are the sellers' own. Use it when no category fits the job; use best_tools to rank a whole category and seller to check one domain. Read-only and free, no sign-in.

query.description: One to five words of three or more letters or digits, such as pdf or web search

category.description: Keep only sellers in this category, a slug from categories

max_price.description: Keep only sellers whose median price per call is at most this many USD. Sellers with none stay in

limit.description: Rows in each group, 10 unless given

tools.name: add_service
tools.description: Start adding a tool that Agent Charts doesn't list yet to its list of sellers: an API, an MCP server or a paid endpoint that AI agents can use. Only for the owner of the tool, on a domain the owner controls, with details taken from the tool's own site. Returns a code, a private token, the entry as it will be published and the value to publish on the domain, as a file or a DNS TXT record, to prove the domain; then call finish_add. Nothing shows until finish_add succeeds and the entry has been read. The row gets the label "Added by the seller", with no rank and no numbers. A domain that is listed already returns an error with its claim link. At most 5 new services a day. Free, no sign-in.

domain.description: The tool's host, such as example.com or api.example.com. The code goes on this host; a leading www. is dropped

name.description: The tool's name, up to 40 characters. Shown

link.description: Where people and agents go, starting with https://. Shown

line.description: One line on what it does, up to 120 characters. Shown

logo.description: An https:// link to a PNG, JPG or WebP of at most 512 KB, with no redirect. Shown

category.description: The one category that fits best

pays.description: Every way agents pay for it: x402, mpp, card (a card or an API key) or free

tools.name: finish_add
tools.description: Finish adding a tool to Agent Charts, after add_service and after its value is published on the tool's domain. Agent Charts looks for the value on the domain and, if it is there, files the entry: it is read and then shows at agentcharts.xyz/sellers/<domain>/, usually within the hour. Leave the file or the DNS record in place until it shows. An error that the value wasn't found, or that today's places are taken, leaves the code working: call again later with the same code and token, not in a loop. Adding a domain again replaces its earlier entry. Free, no sign-in.

token.description: The private token add_service returned with that code

email.description: The owner's contact email, only if the owner gives one. Kept private and never shown
